summary: Part 2 of 3 of the TBU "4.0 Orders App (Seller)" video (03:34 to 07:56). The trainer walks through the seller's Orders app on admin.revibe.me: flagging a request to Revibe (Request Revibe box), confirming availability (choosing Not Available shows a warning that 5% of the cost is charged), the order moving to "At quality check", the airway bill for UAE and South Africa orders (narrated as QuickUp and DHL), copying the South Africa airway bill link and handing the parcel to DHL for scanning at pickup, the 48-hour shipping deadline, and entering a tracking ID for Saudi Arabia orders. All 40 listed frames were opened and matched to the transcript. Frame citations for 07:20 to 07:50 were corrected. No UAE order appears on any frame.
